# T-1: Revise AGENTS templates

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Remove the mandatory flow/direct edit startup choice from English and Japanese AGENTS templates while preserving manual flow guidance.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Templates do not require a two-way confirmation for ordinary requests.
- Templates state explicit user instruction as the flow start condition.
- Templates avoid presenting client-specific notation as the general condition.

## Implementation Notes
Update only source templates under src/presets/base/templates/*/AGENTS.senti.md. Do not edit generated docs directly.

## Test Strategy
Use unit or spec-local text checks to assert old mandatory confirmation text is absent and explicit-start wording is present. Spec-local files must start with `// spec: R<N> ...` headers.
